title: Protections
intro: Control when writes to {{device}} are allowed, using observations from other equipment.
emptyDescription: Add a condition that must be met before a specific write can be sent to this device.
name: Name
explanationHelp: Explain the equipment relationship and why this write must be guarded.
targetHelp: This protection applies only to the selected attribute and requested value on this device.
conditionHelp: A true condition allows the write. A known prohibition blocks it. Unknown or stale information blocks automatic commands and requires explicit, recorded confirmation for manual commands.
brokenPoint: The point {{device}} / {{attribute}} is missing or unavailable. Select a valid replacement.
candidateHelp: The value requested by the protected write, without changing the equipment state.
implicitPoint: This reference needs an explicit device
emptyAll: An empty “all” condition is always true.
emptyAny: An empty “any” condition is always false.

operatorLabel.lte: Is less than or equal to
operatorLabel.gte: Is greater than or equal to
operatorLabel.any: At least one condition is true

formInvalid: Complete the required fields and check the selected points, values and conditions.
invalidDefinition: The protection is invalid. Check the point types, acquisition cadence and condition structure.
failed: Unable to save or load this protection. Please try again.
conflict: This protection changed since you opened it. Your draft is preserved. Load the latest version and review it before saving again.
reconcileHelp: Review the saved version above. You can use it, or keep your draft for the next save. Saving your draft will replace this version.
keepDraft: Keep my draft for the next save
retireHelp: This removes the protection from write checks. Explain why it is no longer needed; your identity, reason and the time will remain in its history.
retiredHelp: This protection has been retired. Its history remains available; it can no longer be edited.
readOnly: Only administrators can create, edit or retire protections.
limits: A protection refuses a write; it never stops equipment. Concurrent starts are not mutually exclusive and hardware interlocks remain necessary where required.
notEnforced: A referenced point no longer exists — this protection is not enforced.
